prompt: During session resume and checkpoint rewind, the session identifier read from shared checkpoint metadata flows into a filesystem write path unchecked. A crafted identifier can escape the intended per-session directory and overwrite unrelated files anywhere on disk, with no prompt to the user. Reject unsafe identifiers before any path is built so a restore can never write outside the session directory. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: validate session id on resume and rewind
path traversal via checkpoint metadata session id
where session ids are validated when checkpoints are written
restore path arbitrary file write from session id
agents that return absolute session ids verbatim
_subject: fix: validate session IDs on resume/rewind to prevent arbitrary file write
